budget_interval: all v3 machine execution from guarded genesis; excludes disclosed pre-epoch v2 history
crash_rule: uncertain issuance/body/work stays conservatively reserved or BLOCKED, never refunded
epoch_start_artifact: epoch_start.json in execution_root; NOT CREATED by this decision
epoch_start_required_bindings: approved implementation commit and code/dependency hashes

first_network_boundary.eligible_only_after: independent phase-P authorization and durable epoch_start

imports_allowed: hash-allowlisted planning metadata and scientific identity only; actual copies consume v3 resources

meters.disk: actual current and peak footprint including controls/partials/caches/temp/duplicates, persistent during pause
meters.memory: live process-tree RSS plus conservative allocator/base/output reservations; unknown live usage fails closed
meters.network: actual physical attempts/redirects/retries and all returned bodies
meters.pause: only sealed quiescent administrative review with workers stopped; no active work or counter reset
meters.time: cumulative active machine seconds per arm/file, absolute per-request timeout; also report wall time

restart_rule: same ledgers, totals, reservations and remaining budgets; no reset or fresh root
root_rules: no alternate root under epoch ID
no X: or shared cache spill
stages: M reporting before T unblinding; later publication spends remaining resources
start_rule: durable atomic genesis and initial ledgers before any socket; failure keeps gate closed
